In the lower center of the frame, there is a circular inset video showing a woman singing from a vintage music video. (2) The man begins to play the electronic keyboard with both hands. His fingers move across the white and black keys with focused precision. Large white and yellow text overlays appear in the middle of the frame. The background features a bookshelf and soft, decorative string lights, creating a cozy and intimate indoor home studio atmosphere. (3) A montage begins, featuring grainy, old film-style footage of a woman with short hair (Tarcy Su) interspersed with recent clips of the man sitting next to her in a room filled with CD shelves. They are both smiling and laughing; the woman is wearing a light yellow top and the man is wearing a blue shirt. (4) The camera remains on the man in the vest as he continues to play the piano and sing. He occasionally looks down at the keys or slightly away from the camera, his facial expressions reflecting the emotional tone of the song. The room remains dimly lit with a red glow visible on a surface behind him. (5) The man finishes the performance, looking directly into the camera with a wide smile. He then makes a humorous, exaggerated facial expression, squinting his eyes and opening his mouth as if letting out a sigh or a comedic sound, before the video cuts to a final caption screen.
